title: Gemini
desc: Gemini, a good-hearted thug embroiled in a power struggle with a vicious gang lord, quits the life of crime and turns over a new leaf for the sake of love.

title: Naiyaandi
desc: Chinna and Vanaroja are in love, but in an unexpected turn of events, her marriage is fixed with someone else. Vanaroja escapes and comes to live with Chinna's family, but his brothers fall for her.

title: Thozha
desc: A millionaire who is a quadriplegic hires an ex-convict as his caretaker. As they spend time together, they begin to empathise with each other and learn valuable life lessons.

title: Pottu
desc: Arjun fails to perform well in academics and tries to commit suicide by cutting his wrist. However, when his blood spills on the tomb of Pottu, she possesses him to exact revenge from her wrongdoers.

title: Kalakalappu
desc: While Seenu struggles to save his family's restaurant, he falls for Madhavi, a health inspector keen on shutting down the place. Things get more complicated when his brother gets released from prison.
